2. This writ petition is instituted by the cousin of detenu Sabavath Shankar, challenging the order of detention dated 27.05.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986).
3.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard Sri P.Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for home.
4. The order of detention is made on the ground of involvement in four crimes by the detenu.
These four crimes are registered under Sections 323, 356, 379, 354 and 382 of Indian Penal Code.
In Cr.No.111 of 200, it is alleged that the detenu snatched away gold nuptial thread from the neck of the wife of complainant.
In Cr.No.128 of 2020, it was alleged that the detenu snatched away gold nuptial thread weighing two tulas infront of the house of complainant.
In Cr.Nos.132 & 146 of 2020 also similar allegations were made.
5. It is not in dispute that in all these crimes, the competent Court has granted bail.
Last of the bail order was granted on 26.11.2020 in Cr.No.146 of 2020.
That being so, the order of detention is passed on 27.05.2021.

It is not disputed that after securing bail in the last of the crime on 26.11.2020, no further crime is reported against the detenu in the six months period between the last bail order and the order of detention.

It cannot be said that the crime reported against the detenu are grave and heinous crimes but all are routine offences liable for prosecution by following the procedure under Code of Criminal Procedure before the competent Court.
These crimes cannot attract the disturbance to public order and the order of detention is liable to be set aside.

6. The Writ Petition is accordingly allowed and the respondents are directed to set the detenu namely Sabavath Shankar S/o.Goriya Nayak Age: 30 yrs, Caste : Lambada, Occu : Mason R/o.Erla thanda of Khilla Ghanpur Mandal, Wanaparthy District at liberty forthwith if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

P.NAVEEN RAO,J ______________________ Dr. G.RADHA RANI,J 16th February, 2022 Rds S. Hanumanthu vs The State Of Telangana on 16 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75043735/
